call_points.text: Departmental store openings guidance raised from 9-10 to 12 stores for the year.
Festive season start showed mid-teens like-for-like growth in stores for Pujo and Dussehra.
Management expects to be debt-free by Q4 FY27 supported by internal accruals.
The company reduced debt by ₹109 Cr and remains on track to be debt-free by FY27.
Department stores recorded LFL sales growth of 4.7%, highest in the last 10 years.

operating_notes.text: Department Stores recorded LFL Sales growth of 4.7% in FY26.
Two promoter group entities with zero shareholding sought re-classification to public shareholder on May 11, 2026.
Global SS Beauty Brands Limited recorded a turnover of ₹379.75 Cr for FY 2025-26.
GSSBBL turnover: ₹95.73 Cr in FY24, ₹220.02 Cr in FY25 and ₹379.75 Cr in FY26.
Shoppers Stop holds 100% of GSSBBL equity (4,99,994 shares plus six with nominees) and ₹125 Cr of NOCPS after the May 20, 2026 first tranche.

CRISIL reaffirmed Shoppers Stop's bank loan facilities of ₹450 Cr at CRISIL A+/Stable / A1+ and enhanced subsidiary Global SS Beauty Brands Limited's rated facilities from ₹120 Cr to ₹180 Cr (CRISIL A/Stable / A1).
Loyalty membership base grew to 14.1 million with record additions.
Shoppers Stop subscribed to second tranche of GSSBBL rights issue for ₹10 Cr, taking total preference investment to ₹135 Cr.

timeline.summary: Shoppers Stop reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,210 Cr (+14% YoY) and full-year FY26 revenue of ₹6,057 Cr.
Shoppers Stop received May 11, 2026 requests from two promoter group entities holding zero shares each to re-classify as public shareholders, subject to board approval.
Shoppers Stop invested ₹20 Cr in the first tranche of its rights issue subscription in material subsidiary Global SS Beauty Brands Limited.
2026-05-20: Shoppers Stop subscribed the first ₹20 Cr tranche of GSSBBL's NOCPS rights issue, taking its preference investment in the beauty subsidiary to ₹125 Cr of a ₹40 Cr approval.
CRISIL reaffirmed Shoppers Stop's bank loan ratings at A+/Stable/A1+ for ₹450 Cr and enhanced GSSBBL's rated facilities to ₹180 Cr in June 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,366.27 Cr (+8.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹3.27 Cr (against a loss of ₹20.1 Cr a year earlier).
Shoppers Stop reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,366 Cr and a net profit of ₹3 Cr, continuing its profitability turnaround.
Shoppers Stop reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue growth of 7% YoY and a PAT turnaround to ₹6 Cr.
Shoppers Stop invested ₹10 Cr in the second tranche of GSSBBL's preference shares rights issue on October 26, 2026.
